component.name: Ephervex
component.summary: Disposable Minecraft environments for reproducing bugs

description.p: Ephervex is a Linux-first Minecraft launcher and developer tool for disposable bug-reproduction environments. It creates temporary or persistent instances, preserves exact game and loader selections, and keeps downloaded artifacts in shared verified stores.

New and imported instances are temporary by default. Minecraft, loader, mod, and pack versions are never silently upgraded, downgraded, or approximated. A client instance can have a linked dedicated server with matching installation data, direct connection, and retained diagnostics.
